blocks.zh: 測試與允收標準
blocks.en: Testing and Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 精確掌握 LVP（大量注射劑，>100 mL）和 SVP（小量注射劑，≤100 mL）的微粒限值，以及「per mL」與「per container」的計算差異
blocks.en: Know the particle limits for LVPs (large-volume injections, >100 mL) and SVPs (small-volume injections, ≤100 mL), and the difference between "per mL" and "per container" calculations

blocks.zh: 理解 Method 1（光阻法）和 Method 2（顯微法）各自的允收限值，以及為何顯微法限值更嚴格
blocks.en: Understand the acceptance limits for Method 1 (light obscuration) and Method 2 (microscopic), and why the microscopic limits are stricter

blocks.zh: 掌握 100 mL 容器歸類為 SVP 的規則（適用 Test 1.B / 2.B）
blocks.en: Know the rule that classifies a 100 mL container as an SVP (Test 1.B / 2.B applies)

blocks.zh: 理解「超標後轉用顯微法複測」的判定邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the decision logic for retesting by the microscopic method after an out-of-limit result

blocks.zh: 掌握 CDMO 場景中微粒測試與 〈790〉 目視檢查的互補關係及批次放行決策
blocks.en: Understand how particulate testing and <790> visual inspection complement each other in a CDMO setting, and how they feed the batch release decision

blocks.zh: 1.1 Method 1 Evaluation — 光阻法判定標準
blocks.en: 1.1 Method 1 Evaluation: Light Obscuration Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 公式計算 LVP vs SVP 單位換算
blocks.en: Calculation: LVP vs SVP Unit Conversion

blocks.zh:
LVP 範例（500 mL 輸液袋）：
  限值: ≤25 per mL (≥10 µm)
  整袋容許總數: 25 × 500 = 12,500 個 (≥10 µm)
  整袋容許總數: 3 × 500 = 1,500 個 (≥25 µm)

SVP 範例（5 mL 小瓶）：
  限值: ≤6000 per container (≥10 µm)
  換算每 mL: 6000 ÷ 5 = 1,200 per mL

SVP 範例（50 mL 小瓶）：
  限值: ≤6000 per container (≥10 µm)
  換算每 mL: 6000 ÷ 50 = 120 per mL
blocks.en:
LVP example (500 mL infusion bag):
  Limit: ≤25 per mL (≥10 µm)
  Total allowed per bag: 25 × 500 = 12,500 particles (≥10 µm)
  Total allowed per bag: 3 × 500 = 1,500 particles (≥25 µm)

SVP example (5 mL vial):
  Limit: ≤6000 per container (≥10 µm)
  Converted per mL: 6000 ÷ 5 = 1,200 per mL

SVP example (50 mL vial):
  Limit: ≤6000 per container (≥10 µm)
  Converted per mL: 6000 ÷ 50 = 120 per mL

blocks.zh: 重要發現：SVP 的「per container」限值換算成 per mL 後，遠高於 LVP 的 25 per mL。這是因為 SVP 注射量小，患者暴露的總微粒數受容器大小自然限制。
blocks.en: Key finding: Once the SVP "per container" limit is converted to a per mL figure, it is far higher than the LVP limit of 25 per mL. This is because an SVP delivers only a small volume, so the total particle burden the patient receives is naturally capped by the container size.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 100 mL 的歸類規則
blocks.en: Key Point: The 100 mL Classification Rule

blocks.zh: 100 mL = SVP：USP 明確規定，標稱容量恰好為 100 mL 的容器適用 Test 1.B（SVP 標準），不是 Test 1.A（LVP 標準）。這是一個常見的混淆點。
blocks.en: 100 mL = SVP: USP states explicitly that a container with a nominal volume of exactly 100 mL is tested against Test 1.B (the SVP criteria), not Test 1.A (the LVP criteria). This is a common source of confusion.

blocks.zh: 記憶口訣：「大於 100 才是 LVP」— 只有大於 100 mL 的才用 Test 1.A，100 mL 及以下都用 Test 1.B。
blocks.en: Memory aid: "Only above 100 is an LVP." Only containers greater than 100 mL use Test 1.A; 100 mL and below all use Test 1.B.

blocks.zh: 超標後的處理：如果 Method 1 結果超過限值，不代表「不合格」— 而是要轉用 Method 2（顯微法）進行複測。只有 Method 2 也超標，才最終判定不合格。這給了產品一個「上訴」的機會。
blocks.en: What happens after an out-of-limit result: A Method 1 result above the limit does not mean the product "fails." Instead, you retest using Method 2 (microscopic). Only if Method 2 also exceeds the limit is the product finally judged non-conforming. This gives the product a chance to "appeal."

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 酒測的兩階段檢測：
blocks.en: A two-stage alcohol test:

blocks.zh: Method 1 超標就像路邊酒測（breathalyzer）吹出超標值 — 這還不算最終定論。警察會帶你回警局用更精確的血液測試（Method 2）來確認。如果血液測試也超標，那才是正式的違規認定。
blocks.en: A Method 1 exceedance is like blowing over the limit on a roadside breathalyzer: it is not the final verdict. The police take you to the station for a more accurate blood test (Method 2). Only if the blood test also exceeds the limit is it a formal violation.

blocks.zh: 在微粒測試中，光阻法可能把氣泡或半透明的蛋白質聚集體誤判為固態微粒，所以用顯微法來做最終確認是科學上合理的。
blocks.en: In particulate testing, light obscuration can miscount air bubbles or translucent protein aggregates as solid particles, so it is scientifically sound to use the microscopic method for final confirmation.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一批 250 mL 的 NS（生理食鹽水）輸液袋，光阻法測試結果為 ≥10 µm 粒子平均 28 per mL。這個結果是合格還是需要進一步測試？為什麼？
blocks.en: A batch of 250 mL NS (normal saline) infusion bags gives a light obscuration result of 28 per mL on average for particles ≥10 µm. Does this pass, or is further testing needed? Why?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶問：「為什麼 5 mL 的小瓶允許 6000 個 ≥10 µm 的微粒（換算 1200/mL），而 500 mL 的輸液袋只允許 25/mL？小瓶不是更應該嚴格嗎？」你如何解釋？
blocks.en: Your client asks: "Why does a 5 mL vial get to have 6000 particles ≥10 µm (equivalent to 1200/mL), while a 500 mL infusion bag is allowed only 25/mL? Shouldn't the small vial be held to a stricter limit?" How do you explain it?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Method 1 光阻法允收限值
blocks.en: Core Concept: Method 1 (Light Obscuration) Acceptance Limits

blocks.zh: 關鍵區分：LVP 以「每毫升」（per mL）計，SVP 以「每容器」（per container）計。這個差異有深遠的實務意義 — 見下方公式計算。
blocks.en: Key distinction: LVPs are counted "per mL," while SVPs are counted "per container." This difference has far-reaching practical consequences; see the calculation below.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Method 2 Evaluation — 顯微法判定標準
blocks.en: 1.2 Method 2 Evaluation: Microscopic Method Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 初試 vs 複試的及格線：
blocks.en: Pass mark for the first test vs the retest:

blocks.zh: 想像大學入學考試有兩個階段：初試（Method 1）及格線是 60 分，複試（Method 2）及格線是 70 分。為什麼複試更嚴？因為到了複試階段，你已經有機會排除初試中的「干擾因素」（題目理解錯誤、考場噪音等），所以在更純淨的條件下，標準自然更高。
blocks.en: Imagine a university entrance exam with two stages: the pass mark for the first round (Method 1) is 60, and for the second round (Method 2) it is 70. Why is the second round stricter? By then, you have had the chance to rule out "interfering factors" from the first round (misreading a question, noise in the exam room, and so on), so under cleaner conditions the standard is naturally higher.

blocks.zh: 同理，顯微法排除了光阻法中的假陽性（氣泡、透明蛋白質聚集體），所以用更嚴格的限值來判定是合理的。
blocks.en: Likewise, the microscopic method eliminates the false positives of light obscuration (air bubbles, transparent protein aggregates), so it is reasonable to judge it against a stricter limit.

blocks.zh: 一批 10 mL 西林瓶產品，Method 1 測試結果：≥10 µm = 7200 per container（超過 6000 限值）。轉用 Method 2 後結果：≥10 µm = 2800 per container。這批產品最終是否合格？
blocks.en: A batch of 10 mL vials gives a Method 1 result of ≥10 µm = 7200 per container (above the 6000 limit). Retested by Method 2, the result is ≥10 µm = 2800 per container. Does the batch finally pass?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 不直接讓所有產品都用 Method 2（更精確、限值更嚴格），而是先用 Method 1？從效率和實務的角度分析。
blocks.en: Why doesn't USP simply have every product use Method 2 (more accurate, stricter limits) instead of starting with Method 1? Analyze from the standpoint of efficiency and practicality.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Method 1 vs Method 2 限值比較
blocks.en: Key Point: Method 1 vs Method 2 Limit Comparison

blocks.zh: 為什麼顯微法限值更嚴格？因為顯微法是「仲裁方法」— 當光阻法超標時才使用。光阻法可能會把氣泡、蛋白質聚集體等非固態微粒誤判為粒子（假陽性），而顯微法由操作員直接觀察，可以排除這些假陽性。因此顯微法的「真實粒子數」應該更低，所以限值也設得更嚴格。
blocks.en: Why are the microscopic limits stricter? Because the microscopic method is the "referee method," used only when light obscuration exceeds the limit. Light obscuration may misread non-solid matter such as air bubbles and protein aggregates as particles (false positives), whereas in the microscopic method an operator observes directly and can exclude these false positives. The "true particle count" seen by microscopy should therefore be lower, so the limits are set more strictly.

blocks.zh: 1.3 Complete Acceptance Limits — 完整允收限值總表
blocks.en: 1.3 Complete Acceptance Limits: Summary Table

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Complete Limits Reference
blocks.en: Complete Limits Reference

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 判定流程
blocks.en: Core Concept: Decision Flow

blocks.zh: Method 1 光阻法測試
blocks.en: Method 1 light obscuration test

blocks.zh: 結果 ≤ 限值 → 合格 (PASS)
blocks.en: Result ≤ limit → PASS

blocks.zh: ↓ 超標
blocks.en: ↓ exceeds limit

blocks.zh: Method 2 顯微法複測
blocks.en: Method 2 microscopic retest

blocks.zh: 不合格 (FAIL) → 偏差調查
blocks.en: FAIL → deviation investigation

blocks.zh: 注意：只有當 Method 2 也超標時才判定不合格。如果 Method 2 結果在限值內，即使 Method 1 超標，產品仍然合格。
blocks.en: Note: The product is judged non-conforming only if Method 2 also exceeds the limit. If the Method 2 result is within the limit, the product still passes even though Method 1 exceeded it.

blocks.zh: 公式計算 Pharmacy Bulk Package 範例
blocks.en: Calculation: Pharmacy Bulk Package Example

blocks.zh:
藥局散裝瓶（Pharmacy Bulk Package）範例：
  總體積: 100 mL
  標示最大劑量: 10 mL

步驟：
  1. 用 Method 1 測試整瓶，取得平均粒子數/mL
  2. 計算結果 = 平均粒子數/mL × 10 mL（最大劑量）
  3. 用 SVP 標準（Test 1.B）判定

  例: 平均 450 粒子/mL (≥10 µm)
  結果 = 450 × 10 = 4,500 per container（最大劑量容器）
  判定: 4,500 ≤ 6,000 → 合格
blocks.en:
Pharmacy Bulk Package example:
  Total volume: 100 mL
  Labeled maximum dose: 10 mL

Steps:
  1. Test the whole container by Method 1 to obtain the mean particle count per mL
  2. Calculated result = mean particles per mL × 10 mL (maximum dose)
  3. Evaluate against the SVP criteria (Test 1.B)

  Example: mean 450 particles/mL (≥10 µm)
  Result = 450 × 10 = 4,500 per container (maximum-dose container)
  Decision: 4,500 ≤ 6,000 → PASS

blocks.zh: 重點提示 特殊產品的處理
blocks.en: Key Point: Handling Special Products

blocks.zh: 雙腔室產品（Dual Compartment）：如凍乾製劑配合預灌封溶媒，測試前必須按標示方式混合、搖勻並確保完全溶解。這模擬了臨床使用前的「復溶」步驟。測試的是患者實際會注射的成品狀態。
blocks.en: Dual compartment products: For example, a lyophilized product supplied with a prefilled diluent must be mixed as labeled, shaken, and fully dissolved before testing. This simulates the clinical "reconstitution" step, so that what is tested is the finished product in the state the patient would actually be injected.

blocks.zh: 粉末注射劑（Powders for Parenteral Use）：需用無粒子水（或適當無粒子溶劑）復溶後再測試。復溶本身可能引入微粒（如穿刺膠塞產生的橡膠屑），這也是測試要控制的一部分。
blocks.en: Powders for parenteral use: These must be reconstituted with particle-free water (or a suitable particle-free solvent) before testing. Reconstitution itself may introduce particles (such as rubber fragments from stopper puncture), and this is part of what the test is meant to control.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠生產一種凍乾注射劑（20 mL 西林瓶，凍乾粉 + 預灌封注射用水 10 mL）。混合後總體積約 12 mL。做 〈788〉 測試時，這個產品應歸類為 LVP 還是 SVP？你會如何準備測試樣品？
blocks.en: Your facility makes a lyophilized injectable (20 mL vial, lyophilized powder + 10 mL prefilled water for injection). After mixing, the total volume is about 12 mL. For <788> testing, should this product be classified as an LVP or an SVP? How would you prepare the test samples?

blocks.zh: 一批產品 〈788〉 Method 1 結果正常（遠低於限值），但 〈790〉 目視檢查發現不合格率異常升高（3% vs 正常 0.5%）。這代表什麼？你會採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: A batch gives a normal <788> Method 1 result (well below the limit), but <790> visual inspection shows an abnormally high reject rate (3% vs the normal 0.5%). What does this mean, and what action would you take?

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Correlation with 〈790〉 Visual Inspection
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: Correlation with <790> Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 〈788〉 次可見微粒 vs 〈790〉 可見微粒的互補關係：
blocks.en: How <788> subvisible particles and <790> visible particles complement each other:

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略：〈788〉 和 〈790〉 是注射劑微粒控制的「雙保險」。〈790〉 用 100% 目視檢查剔除含可見微粒的個別單位，〈788〉 用抽樣檢測確認整批次的次可見微粒水平。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: CDMO strategy: <788> and <790> are the "double safeguard" for particulate control in injectables. <790> uses 100% visual inspection to remove individual units containing visible particles, while <788> uses sampled testing to confirm the subvisible particle level of the whole batch. Neither can be dropped.

blocks.zh: 1.4 Batch Release Decision — 批次放行決策
blocks.en: 1.4 Batch Release Decision

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Key Regulatory Context
blocks.en: Key Regulatory Context

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 抽樣計畫設計
blocks.en: Core Concept: Sampling Plan Design

blocks.zh: 為什麼微粒測試的抽樣如此重要：微粒污染具有隨機性和非均勻性。不像含量測試（每瓶中的 API 含量相對一致），微粒可能因為一個偶然事件（如某個瓶子的瓶口有缺損）而導致個別單位的微粒數遠高於其他單位。
blocks.en: Why sampling matters so much in particulate testing: Particulate contamination is random and non-uniform. Unlike an assay (where the API content is fairly consistent from vial to vial), the particle count in an individual unit can be far higher than in the others because of a chance event (for example, a chipped vial neck).

blocks.zh: USP 的靈活性：USP 沒有硬性規定「每批必須測 N 個單位」，而是要求制定「統計學上合理的抽樣計畫」。這給了製造商靈活性，但也要求你有科學依據來支持你的抽樣數量。
blocks.en: USP flexibility: USP does not prescribe "test N units from every batch." Instead it requires a "statistically sound sampling plan." This gives the manufacturer flexibility, but you must also have a scientific rationale to support the number of units you sample.

blocks.zh: 常見抽樣方案參考：
blocks.en: Commonly used sampling schemes:

blocks.zh: SVP（合併測試）：合併 10 瓶 × 3 個合併樣品 = 30 瓶
blocks.en: SVP (pooled testing): pool 10 vials × 3 pooled samples = 30 vials

blocks.zh: LVP（單瓶測試）：通常 3–10 個單位
blocks.en: LVP (single-unit testing): typically 3–10 units

blocks.zh: 依據 ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 或 ISO 2859 等抽樣標準
blocks.en: Based on sampling standards such as ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 or ISO 2859

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO 批次放行檢查清單
blocks.en: Key Point: CDMO Batch Release Checklist

blocks.zh: 完整的注射劑微粒放行決策需要確認：
blocks.en: A complete particulate release decision for an injectable requires confirmation that:

blocks.zh: USP 〈788〉 次可見微粒測試通過（Method 1 或 Method 1 + Method 2）
blocks.en: USP <788> subvisible particle test passes (Method 1, or Method 1 + Method 2)

blocks.zh: USP 〈790〉 可見微粒 100% 目視檢查完成，不合格率在可接受範圍內
blocks.en: USP <790> 100% visual inspection for visible particles is complete, with a reject rate within the acceptable range

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI）測試通過
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity (CCI) testing passes

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗（Sterility Test, USP 〈71〉）通過
blocks.en: Sterility Test (USP <71>) passes

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素（BET, USP 〈85〉）通過
blocks.en: Bacterial endotoxins test (BET, USP <85>) passes

blocks.zh: 其他專論要求的理化測試通過
blocks.en: Physicochemical tests required by other monographs pass

blocks.zh: 〈788〉 微粒測試是這個多重檢驗體系中不可或缺的一環。
blocks.en: The <788> particulate test is an indispensable part of this multi-layer testing system.

blocks.zh: 品管是一張安全網，不是一道牆：
blocks.en: QC is a safety net, not a wall:

blocks.zh: 把注射劑的品質控制想像成一棟大樓的安全系統。〈788〉 微粒測試是其中一個警報器，〈790〉 目視檢查是另一個，〈71〉 無菌試驗是第三個。每個警報器只偵測特定類型的問題 — 微粒、可見異物、微生物污染。
blocks.en: Think of injectable quality control as the safety system of a building. The <788> particulate test is one alarm, the <790> visual inspection is another, and the <71> sterility test is a third. Each alarm detects only one type of problem: particles, visible foreign matter, or microbial contamination.

blocks.zh: 任何一個警報器單獨都無法保證大樓安全，但所有警報器一起運作，就形成了一張嚴密的安全網。這就是為什麼批次放行是一個綜合判定，而不是任何單一測試的「通過/不通過」。
blocks.en: No single alarm can guarantee the building is safe, but all the alarms working together form a tight safety net. This is why batch release is a comprehensive decision and not a "pass/fail" on any single test.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Investigation Triggers
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: Investigation Triggers

blocks.zh: 什麼時候需要啟動調查：
blocks.en: When to start an investigation:

blocks.zh: 超標（OOS） — 任一參數超過 USP 限值 → 啟動 OOS 調查流程
blocks.en: Out of specification (OOS): any parameter exceeds the USP limit → start the OOS investigation process

blocks.zh: 超趨勢（OOT） — 結果在限值內但顯著高於歷史趨勢 → 啟動趨勢調查
blocks.en: Out of trend (OOT): results are within limits but significantly above the historical trend → start a trend investigation

blocks.zh: 異常形態 — 顯微法觀察到異常粒子類型（如金屬微粒、黑色不明粒子）→ 即使數量合格也應調查
blocks.en: Abnormal morphology: unusual particle types seen under the microscope (such as metal particles or unidentified black particles) → investigate even if the count is acceptable

blocks.zh: 批間差異 — 同產品不同批次的微粒計數差異顯著 → 調查製程變異來源
blocks.en: Batch-to-batch variation: particle counts differ markedly between batches of the same product → investigate the source of process variation

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，OOT 調查尤其重要 — 它可以在 OOS 發生之前預警，讓你有時間進行製程調整。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, OOT investigation is especially important: it gives early warning before an OOS occurs, leaving time to adjust the process.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠生產 2 mL 小瓶注射劑，批量 20,000 瓶。設計一個符合 USP 〈788〉 要求的抽樣計畫，說明你需要抽取多少瓶，如何合併，以及如何計算結果。
blocks.en: Your facility makes a 2 mL vial injectable with a batch size of 20,000 vials. Design a sampling plan that meets USP <788> requirements: state how many vials you need to sample, how to pool them, and how to calculate the result.

blocks.zh: 連續三批相同產品的 ≥10 µm 微粒計數分別為 800、1500、3200（per container）。雖然都在 6000 的限值內，但趨勢明顯上升。你會採取什麼行動？從哪些製程變數開始調查？
blocks.en: Three consecutive batches of the same product show ≥10 µm particle counts of 800, 1500, and 3200 (per container). All are within the 6000 limit, but the trend is clearly rising. What action would you take, and which process variables would you start investigating?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求將 〈788〉 的內部接受標準設為 USP 限值的 50%（即 ≥10 µm ≤3000 per container）。這個做法在 CDMO 中有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: Your client asks you to set the internal acceptance criterion for <788> at 50% of the USP limit (that is, ≥10 µm ≤3000 per container). What are the advantages and disadvantages of this approach in a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: LVP（>100 mL）限值以 per mL 計：Method 1: ≤25(≥10 µm), ≤3(≥25 µm); Method 2: ≤12(≥10 µm), ≤2(≥25 µm)
blocks.en: LVP (>100 mL) limits are expressed per mL: Method 1: ≤25 (≥10 µm), ≤3 (≥25 µm); Method 2: ≤12 (≥10 µm), ≤2 (≥25 µm)

blocks.zh: SVP（≤100 mL）限值以 per container 計：Method 1: ≤6000(≥10 µm), ≤600(≥25 µm); Method 2: ≤3000(≥10 µm), ≤300(≥25 µm)
blocks.en: SVP (≤100 mL) limits are expressed per container: Method 1: ≤6000 (≥10 µm), ≤600 (≥25 µm); Method 2: ≤3000 (≥10 µm), ≤300 (≥25 µm)

blocks.zh: 100 mL 歸類為 SVP（適用 Test 1.B / 2.B），只有 >100 mL 才是 LVP
blocks.en: 100 mL is classified as an SVP (Test 1.B / 2.B applies); only >100 mL is an LVP

blocks.zh: 判定流程：Method 1 通過 → 合格；Method 1 超標 → 轉 Method 2 複測；Method 2 通過 → 合格；Method 2 也超標 → 不合格
blocks.en: Decision flow: Method 1 passes → PASS; Method 1 exceeds → retest by Method 2; Method 2 passes → PASS; Method 2 also exceeds → FAIL

blocks.zh: 顯微法限值約為光阻法的 50%，因為顯微法排除了假陽性，測到的是「真實微粒」
blocks.en: Microscopic limits are about 50% of the light obscuration limits, because the microscopic method eliminates false positives and counts "true particles"

blocks.zh: 〈788〉 與 〈790〉 互補：〈788〉 測次可見微粒（抽樣），〈790〉 測可見微粒（100% 全檢），兩者共同構成注射劑微粒控制的完整體系
blocks.en: <788> and <790> are complementary: <788> tests subvisible particles (sampled), <790> tests visible particles (100% inspection), and together they form a complete particulate control system for injectables

blocks.zh: CDMO 內部管控：建議設定嚴於 USP 限值的內部接受標準（如 50%–70% USP 限值），並監控趨勢以預防 OOS
blocks.en: CDMO internal controls: set internal acceptance criteria stricter than the USP limits (for example 50%–70% of the USP limit) and monitor trends to prevent OOS
